original_client_text.markup_text:
These are “beat up / undervalued” names where a single catalyst can flip sentiment fast.

1) PayPal (PYPL)

Why undervalued: crushed on weak outlook + leadership uncertainty
What could send it: branded checkout re-acceleration + margins/FCF stay strong + clear turnaround plan
Risk: competition + guidance keeps slipping
Watch: next earnings + branded checkout trends

2) Intel (INTC)

Why undervalued: market still doubts the foundry turnaround
What could send it: real progress on roadmap/yields + credible customer wins
Risk: execution delays + intense competition
Watch: roadmap updates + foundry traction

3) Pfizer (PFE)

Why undervalued: post-COVID sentiment is still depressed
What could send it: pipeline wins + strong 2026 catalyst calendar + improved outlook
Risk: patent cliffs + trial disappointments + pricing pressure
Watch: key trial readouts + new launch momentum

4) Citigroup (C)

Why undervalued: “restructuring story” — market wants proof
What could send it: visible efficiency gains + improving returns (ROTCE trajectory)
Risk: credit cycle + regulation + slower deal activity
Watch: expenses, credit losses, return metrics

5) Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY)

Why undervalued: patent cliff fear weighs heavy
What could send it: growth portfolio proving it can offset declines + pipeline catalysts
Risk: faster erosion / trial failures
Watch: growth-drug sales trend + trial updates

👉 Want me to turn this into a Top 3 “highest upside” picks based on your risk level? DM me “VALUE”.
